snippet.title: Ghost Vanguard Steam Trailer 01
snippet.description:
Unleash stylish devastation in Ghost Vanguard, a Dark Fantasy Beat 'em Up infused with intense Roguelike progression.
Step into a world of shadow and steel as you carve through treacherous dungeons to reclaim a hero’s stolen soul. Master a combat system where fluid 2D side-scrolling action meets In-depth build crafting. Every weapon, spell, and relic you find unlocks powerful synergies, allowing you to craft a unique combo style for every run.
